dialogue.content: こんにちは。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: 相談者役です。よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: I'm playing the role of the client. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: 承認ありがとうございますお時間になりましたらお声掛けします。はたまた、もしもご都合よろしければ始める準備は私は整っていますがいかがですか。。。(^^
dialogue.English: Thank you for the approval. I'll let you know when it's time. Or, if it's convenient for you, I'm ready to start. How does that sound? (^^

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、急な申し出にも関わらず、承認ありがとうございました！すみませんが、13時からの開始でお願いできますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for approving on such short notice. I’m sorry, but could we please start at 1:00 p.m.?

dialogue.content: 承知いたしました！無理な催促すみません。。。では、お時間になりましたらお声掛けしますね(^^
dialogue.English: Understood! I'm sorry for rushing you... I'll let you know when it's time, then. (^^

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。ご準備整いましたら、今日のご相談についてお話しましょう。
dialogue.English: Hello, this is your counselor. When you’re ready, let’s talk about what brings you in today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: きょうはどうなさいましたか？
dialogue.English: What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 大学受験したんで試験を受けたんです
dialogue.English: I took my university entrance exams.

dialogue.content: でも、たぶん落ちて。
dialogue.English: But I probably failed.

dialogue.content: 2浪で受験したのに、自分、何やってたんだろうって
dialogue.English: I studied for two extra years for this exam, and now I'm just wondering what I was even doing.

dialogue.content: 受験、お疲れさまでした。コロナ禍での受験、大変でしたよね。
dialogue.English: You must be exhausted from the exams. Taking them during the COVID-19 pandemic must have been very difficult.

dialogue.content: 情けなくて。この先どうしたらいいのかもわからなくて。
dialogue.English: I just feel pathetic. I don’t know what to do from here.

dialogue.content: 本当に、大変でした。
dialogue.English: It really was very hard.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいかわからないまま、時が過ぎて。
dialogue.English: Time just keeps passing and I still don’t know what to do.

dialogue.content: 落ちた。。。そのように思ってしまうんですね。。
dialogue.English: ‘I failed’... That’s how it feels to you right now.

dialogue.content: 自己採点してみましたが、絶望的でした。もしかしたらとも思えない。
dialogue.English: I tried grading it myself, and it looked hopeless. I can’t even imagine a ‘maybe.’

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 点数で見てしまうと、とても悪い方向に考えが及んでしまうのも、
dialogue.English: When you look at the score, it's natural for your thoughts to turn in a very negative direction.

dialogue.content: 無理ないかと思います。
dialogue.English: That's completely understandable.

dialogue.content: きっと、精一杯努力して、受験の日を迎えたのでしょうね
dialogue.English: I'm sure you worked as hard as you could and gave it your all on exam day.

dialogue.content: 2浪で。わがまま言って浪人させてもらってたのに、
dialogue.English: After studying for two extra years... I was so selfish to ask them to let me do that, and yet...

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何もできなかった。来年は妹が受験なんです。
dialogue.English: I couldn't accomplish anything. And my younger sister has her entrance exams next year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: これ以上は、わがまま言えない、崖っぷちだったのに。
dialogue.English: I couldn't be any more selfish. I was on the edge of a cliff.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 親もコロナで収入減っていて。
dialogue.English: My parents’ income has also gone down because of the pandemic.

dialogue.content: えぇえぇ。。
dialogue.English: I hear you...

dialogue.content: 仕事も学業もしなかった自分が情けないです。かと言って、ここから就活は遅いし、たぶんコロナで仕事も少ないだろうし。
dialogue.English: I feel ashamed that I neither worked nor studied. That said, it’s late to start job hunting now, and with COVID there probably aren’t many jobs anyway.

dialogue.content: 人生詰みました
dialogue.English: I feel like my life is over.

dialogue.content: そのようなご事情だったのですね。。
dialogue.English: I see—so that’s the situation you’ve been in.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: たくさんの責任を背負っておられながら、
dialogue.English: You carried so many responsibilities on your shoulders,

dialogue.content: 今年の受験を迎えたのでしょう。。。
dialogue.English: and still faced this year's exams...

dialogue.content: ただでさえコロナで神経すり減る時期に。。。
dialogue.English: during a time when the pandemic has already been wearing everyone down...

dialogue.content: 本当に、まずはお疲れさまです
dialogue.English: Really, first of all, you've done so well to get through it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: では、お話を進める前に、何とお呼びしたらよろしいでしょうか？性別もおしえてください
dialogue.English: Before we go further, how would you like me to address you? And could you tell me your gender?

dialogue.content: ツナって呼んでください。女です。
dialogue.English: Please call me Tsuna. I’m female.

dialogue.content: ツナさん、改めて本当にお疲れさまでした！
dialogue.English: Tsuna, once again, you've really been through a lot!

dialogue.content: ツナさんは、
dialogue.English: Tsuna, you...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 将来何を目指しておられるんですか？
dialogue.English: what are you aiming for in the future?

dialogue.content: 薬剤師。薬学部に入ろうとしていました。
dialogue.English: A pharmacist. I was trying to get into a pharmacy program.

dialogue.content: そうですか！とても素晴らしい。これからの時代にはなくてはならない、お仕事ですよね
dialogue.English: I see! That's wonderful. It's a profession that is absolutely essential for the times ahead, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そう思っています。
dialogue.English: That’s what I think, too.

dialogue.content: 薬剤師になろうとされたきっかけを、教えてくださいますか？
dialogue.English: Would you tell me what led you to want to become a pharmacist?

dialogue.content: もしよければ、です
dialogue.English: If you’re comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: （お待ちしてますね）
dialogue.English: (I’ll wait.)

dialogue.content: 祖父が医者で。頭が良ければ医者になりたかったんたですけど
dialogue.English: My grandfather was a doctor. If I were smarter, I would have wanted to become one, too, but...

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分の学力で医療に携わるなら薬学かなと。
dialogue.English: Given my academic ability, I thought pharmacy would be the way I could be involved in healthcare.

dialogue.content: お医者様だったおじいさまのお姿をみて、
dialogue.English: Seeing your grandfather, who was a doctor,

dialogue.content: 医療に携わりたいと思われたのですね。
dialogue.English: made you want to work in healthcare.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。人の役に立ってて、尊敬されていて、すごくかっこいいなと思ってたんですけど。
dialogue.English: That's right. He was helping people, was respected, and I thought he was so cool, but...

dialogue.content: 素晴らしいおじいさまなのですね。
dialogue.English: He sounds like a wonderful grandfather.

dialogue.content: 尊敬できるおじいさま
dialogue.English: Someone you can truly look up to.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, he is.

dialogue.content: 思ってたんです「けど」？
dialogue.English: You said ‘but’ at the end there?

dialogue.content: 私はなりたかったけど、薬学にすら進めない。
dialogue.English: I wanted to be like him, but I can't even get into pharmacy school.

dialogue.content: そんな風に思われているのですね。。。
dialogue.English: That’s how you’re feeling.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご両親は、なんとおっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.English: What do your parents say about it?

dialogue.content: 親は、実は、祖父に反発して父はラーメン屋なんです。
dialogue.English: My parents... well, actually, my father rebelled against my grandfather and runs a ramen shop.

dialogue.content: ええ！それはすごいです！！
dialogue.English: Wow! That's amazing!

dialogue.content: そこに反発した私が医療に向かうって息巻いて。
dialogue.English: And I, rebelling against that, was fired up about going into healthcare.

dialogue.content: ラーメン屋さん、職人さんもかっこいいですね。
dialogue.English: A ramen shop owner... an artisan is cool, too.

dialogue.content: お父様に反発されたということなのですね？
dialogue.English: So you mean you rebelled against your father?

dialogue.content: 自分は反発して生きてきたけど、私に対しては何も言わず、収入も低いのに、
dialogue.English: He lived his life in rebellion, but he never said anything to me, and even though his income is low,

dialogue.content: そう。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 受験させてくれて。授業料も払ってやるって言ってくれて。
dialogue.English: he let me take the exams. He even said he’d pay my tuition.

dialogue.content: お父様はツナさんのこと、応援してらしたんですね
dialogue.English: Your father was supporting you, wasn't he?

dialogue.content: 2浪までさせてくれて。
dialogue.English: He even let me study for two extra years.

dialogue.content: えぇ。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 精一杯どころか、かなり無理してくれている気がします。
dialogue.English: It feels like he's not just doing his best, but really pushing himself to the limit for me.

dialogue.content: 職人であるお父様。余計なことは言わず、背中を見せてくれることで導いてくれる。。。
dialogue.English: Your father, the artisan. He doesn't say unnecessary things, but leads by example...

dialogue.content: すてきなお父様ですよね
dialogue.English: He’s a wonderful father, isn’t he?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今回、ツナさん、自己採点した点数を見て、
dialogue.English: This time, Tsuna, when you saw your self-scored results,

dialogue.content: 一番なにが思い浮かびましたか？
dialogue.English: what was the very first thing that came to mind?

dialogue.content: お父様の背中？それとも、
dialogue.English: Your father’s example? Or,

dialogue.content: 薬剤師になっている将来の自分の姿？
dialogue.English: an image of yourself as a future pharmacist?

dialogue.content: とにかく、親に申し訳ないって。情けないって思いました。自分の将来も真っ暗だとは思ったけど。一番は親かも。
dialogue.English: More than anything, I felt sorry for my parents. I felt pathetic. I did think my own future was dark, but my parents were my first thought.

dialogue.content: そうですか。。。来年は妹様も受験されるというご事情も、、、
dialogue.English: I see... And with your younger sister taking her exams next year as well,

dialogue.content: ご両親に対して、これ以上は迷惑かけられないというお考えなのかしら？
dialogue.English: you’re thinking you can’t burden your parents any further?

dialogue.content: そう。妹のことも重なったら、さらに親は無理しそうだし。妹も、お金のこととか考えて自分のやりたいこと、やらないかもしれない。
dialogue.English: Right. If my sister’s situation is added to mine, my parents will push themselves even more. And my sister might hold back on what she wants to do because of money.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。。。
dialogue.English: I understand...

dialogue.content: 薬剤師になる夢、これは・・・？
dialogue.English: Your dream of becoming a pharmacist, what about that...?

dialogue.content: やりたくなくなった訳じゃないけど、
dialogue.English: It’s not that I don’t want to do it anymore, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、これ以上自分のことばっかり大切にするのは違うとも思っていてを
dialogue.English: But I also feel it’s wrong to keep prioritizing only myself any further.

dialogue.content: そのように思っておられるのですね。。。
dialogue.English: That’s how you’re feeling.

dialogue.content: 私も家族のこと、大切にしたい。今は一方的に甘えてるから、申し訳ないです。
dialogue.English: I want to cherish my family, too. Right now, I'm just relying on them one-sidedly, so I feel guilty.

dialogue.content: 薬剤師やっぱやめるって言うのも、ここまで支えてもらったのに
dialogue.English: But to say I'm giving up on being a pharmacist now, after they've supported me this far...

dialogue.content: うんうん、、、
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm...

dialogue.content: とも思うし。本当にこの先どうしていいかわからなくて。
dialogue.English: I think that, too, and I really don’t know what to do from here.

dialogue.content: そっか。。。そんなご状況なので、「人生詰んだ」と感じておられるのですね。。
dialogue.English: I see... Given all this, it makes sense that you feel ‘checkmated,’ like life has no moves left.

dialogue.content: 家族と、自分と、理想と、現実と、
dialogue.English: Between my family and myself, my ideals and reality,

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: どこに未来があるのか分からないんです。
dialogue.English: I don't know where my future lies.

dialogue.content: 胸が苦しいね
dialogue.English: That must be heart-wrenching.

dialogue.content: はい。目指すのと、目指せることは違うから。
dialogue.English: Yes. There’s a difference between what you want to aim for and what you’re able to aim for.

dialogue.content: では、ここで少し私が感じたことをお話させていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: May I share a little of what I’m sensing?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ツナさん、あなたはまず第一に優しい方ね！だからこそ薬剤師を目指したのも納得です！
dialogue.English: Tsuna, first and foremost, you are a kind person. That's why it makes perfect sense that you want to be a pharmacist.

dialogue.content: そして、
dialogue.English: And,

dialogue.content: 自分のことはいつも後回しに考えているところがないかしら？
dialogue.English: I wonder if you tend to put yourself last.

dialogue.content: これも、優しいからこそですよね
dialogue.English: That's also because of your kindness, isn't it?

dialogue.content: どうかな、2浪しちゃってるからワガママだと思ってた
dialogue.English: I don't know, I thought I was selfish for studying for two extra years.

dialogue.content: そして、芯が強く、人間性に深みのある人。
dialogue.English: And you have a strong core and a depth of character.

dialogue.content: 2浪する・・・こんな大変なことを決断するほど、薬剤師になりたいのですよね？
dialogue.English: Studying for two extra years... you want to be a pharmacist so much that you decided to do something that difficult, right?

dialogue.content: そっか、そうかもしれないです。
dialogue.English: I guess that might be true.

dialogue.content: だって、そんなになりたくないなら、1回失敗したら「他さ～がそ」ってなりますよね
dialogue.English: Because if you didn’t want it that much, after one setback you’d probably say, “I’ll just look for something else,” right?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That’s true.

dialogue.content: お医者さんでかっこよいおじいさま、職人でかっこよいお父様のように、とても芯がお強い方。
dialogue.English: Like your cool grandfather the doctor, and your cool father the artisan, you are a person with a very strong core.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうですか？
dialogue.English: How does that land with you?

dialogue.content: そんな風に思ってなかってけど。そう思ってもやえるんだなって。
dialogue.English: I never thought of it that way. I guess it's okay to think that way about myself.

dialogue.content: そうですねそして、その芯の強さに加えて、心から優しい方なので、ご両親に気兼ねし、妹様にも気兼ねし、
dialogue.English: Yes—and in addition to that inner strength, because you’re genuinely kind, you’re considerate of your parents and your sister,

dialogue.content: 自分のことは後回しにしてしまう。
dialogue.English: and you end up putting yourself last.

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 違っていたら、訂正してね
dialogue.English: Please correct me if I’m off.

dialogue.content: そっか。全部大事にしたくて。家族も。自分も。
dialogue.English: I see. I want to cherish everything. My family. And myself.

dialogue.content: もっと自分を後回しにできたら、違ったのかもしれないけど
dialogue.English: Maybe if I could have put myself last more, things would have turned out differently, but

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこもきっと、私には譲れない部分だったのかも。
dialogue.English: That might have been something I couldn't compromise on.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ぜーんぶ大切にしたい。バランスを大切にしてきたあなたが、２浪までしてでも
dialogue.English: Exactly. You want to cherish everything. You, who have valued balance so much, went so far as to study for two extra years because

dialogue.content: 薬剤師という夢は譲ることができなかった。
dialogue.English: you couldn’t give up on your dream of being a pharmacist.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 自分の一番にしたい気持ちが見えてきましたね。
dialogue.English: It seems like what you want to prioritize for yourself is becoming clearer.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: I think so.

dialogue.content: 優しいツナさん、人生で初めて意思を通したのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: Kind Tsuna, wasn't this perhaps the first time in your life you've really pushed for what you want?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれないです
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: その薬剤師に対する強い気持ち、ご両親にお話してみたかな？
dialogue.English: Have you tried telling your parents about this strong desire to become a pharmacist?

dialogue.content: 気持ち、は無いかも。目指すことは伝えてきたけど。
dialogue.English: My feelings? Maybe not. I've told them I’m aiming for it, though.

dialogue.content: 是非、伝えてみて！
dialogue.English: You should definitely tell them!

dialogue.content: でも、それが追い詰めるというか、さらに無理しちゃうことに繋がりそうで心配です。
dialogue.English: But I'm worried that will put more pressure on them, or lead them to push themselves even harder.

dialogue.content: その後、具体的に家族会議になると思いますが、収入面ならなんとかバイトや奨学金など、いくらでも方法はあると思います。
dialogue.English: I imagine that would lead to a concrete family discussion, but when it comes to finances, I think there are many options, like part-time jobs and scholarships.

dialogue.content: うん。そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yeah, you're right.

dialogue.content: ご両親への気兼ね、この気持ちをご両親への安心につなげられれば良いですね
dialogue.English: It would be ideal if you could turn your consideration for your parents into reassurance for them.

dialogue.content: こんな大変な情勢の中、２浪して努力のできるツナさんならなんでも乗り越えられる、
dialogue.English: Someone like you, Tsuna, who can work hard for two extra years in such difficult circumstances, can overcome anything.

dialogue.content: そう私は思うのです。
dialogue.English: That’s what I believe.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: あとは、合格発表での大どんでん返しを期待するのみ。
dialogue.English: Now all that's left is to hope for a big pleasant surprise when the results are announced.

dialogue.content: 祈るのみ
dialogue.English: All we can do is pray.

dialogue.content: ここまででどうでしょうか？ツナさんの心のもやもやは少しは晴れるお手伝いができたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling so far? Have I been able to help clear some of the fog in your heart?

dialogue.content: そうですね、きっと“どんでん”はならないけど、もう、できることがある訳じゃないし。
dialogue.English: Well, I'm sure there won't be a "pleasant surprise," but it's not like there's anything else I can do now.

dialogue.content: 1時間ではすこしたりないですね
dialogue.English: One hour isn't quite enough, is it?

dialogue.content: ただ、親には、話してみようって。やりたいことも、心配していることも。
dialogue.English: But I've decided to try talking to my parents. About what I want to do, and about what I'm worried about.

dialogue.content: 妹にも。
dialogue.English: And to my sister, too.

dialogue.content: そうですね。そのツナさんの勇気を私は陰ながら応援していますよ
dialogue.English: That's a great idea. I'll be cheering for your courage from the sidelines.

dialogue.content: できるかも、できないかも、だけど。詰んではいない。
dialogue.English: Maybe I can, maybe I can’t. But I’m not checkmated.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: とてもすてきないい言葉です！人生は詰んでない人生やり直しはいくらでもきく！大丈夫！！
dialogue.English: Those are wonderful words! Life isn’t checkmated—you can always have a do-over. You’ll be okay!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まずは受験で疲れた心と体を休ませてあげてね！自分にご褒美よ
dialogue.English: First, let your tired mind and body rest from the exams. Treat yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: では、またこころが不安でいっぱいになったら、お話しに来てね！
dialogue.English: Well then, if your heart feels full of anxiety again, please come back and talk.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰｰありがとうございました。これでロールプレイを終了してもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: ---------------- Thank you very much. Shall we end the role-play here?

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much!

dialogue.content: ではまたお会いできる日まで、お互いにがんばりましょう(^^
dialogue.English: Until we meet again, let’s both do our best. (^^
